integrity_statement: The formulas follow from a written symplectic finite-geometry argument; finite-field enumerations verify examples without certifying the universal proof. Prior literature may contain an unlocated equivalent formulation.
scientific_limitations: Exact degree census only for the five-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra over finite fields; no result on higher dimension or other Lie types. A relevant dimension-four follow-up was read in abstract only.
title: Five degree strata in the comaximal graph of the five-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra
